name: Maneji! Ikimasu!! ~Chitsuyosen ni Kaketa Natsu 2008~
original_name: マネジ！　イキます！！～膣予選に賭けた夏2008～
source:
Nagisa is a high school student. She falls in love with a male student, who is an ace pitcher of a baseball club, at first sight.
